{{Quote|The voice is familiar&hellip;''"<br />"''The face even more so. Climber. We fought together on Deko Neimoidia.''"<br />"''Good to see you again, Climber&mdash;even here.|Climber and Roan Shryne|<ref name="Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref>}}
The '''siege of Deko Neimoidia''' was fought during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], prior to the fall of [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] and around the time of the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]].

==The battle==
Towards the end of the war, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forced the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] out of its [[Purse world/Legends|purse worlds]] in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]], sending the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidians]] fleeing to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. [[Deko Neimoidia/Legends|Deko Neimoidia]], one such purse world, was invaded by the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[22nd Air Combat Wing]], led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Roan Shryne]].

[[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] were part of the assault on the Trade Federation's citadel, and they were able to use the floorplans of the fortress to the Republic's advantage in their later [[Siege of Cato Neimoidia|attempt to capture]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]]. The [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] of [[Ion Team]] also participated in the battle, and General Shryne earned the respect of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Climber (clone)|Climber]], the team leader who later saved Shryne's life.

Deko Neimoidia fell along with Cato and [[Koru Neimoidia/Legends|Koru Neimoidia]], eventually leading the leaders of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] to set up headquarters on the Outer Rim worlds of [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] and [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]].
